context: [Retrieved Contract Clauses / Statutory Articles] Clause 14.2: Right of withdrawal exercisable within 7 calendar days of receipt. query: I purchased standard headphones on 2026-03-01, delivered on 2026-03-05. On 2026-03-11 I sent an email to support asking for a refund and withdrawal. Can I cancel?

answer: Yes, you are eligible to withdraw from the contract. Under Clause 14.2, you have 7 calendar days from delivery (March 5) to request a refund, and your notice on March 11 (6 days) was timely. Because the headphones are standard inventory rather than custom goods (Clause 14.3), and your email qualifies as written notice under Clause 22, your cancellation is valid. Note that return shipping costs apply pursuant to Clause 14.4.
